subject: Nightly cancellation job started 404ing after version upgrade
body: We finished cutting over from the older API last week. Since then our nightly job that cancels stale authorizations logs 404 on every single call. Nothing else changed, same auth header, same payment ids that we can still fetch fine with a GET. The path we hit is /v3/payments/{id}/void and it just returns not found, no error code in the body at all. If I fetch the same payment it comes back with status authorized so the id is definitely real. Did that route move, or do we need a flag turned on for our account?
